parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

*   service: service
*   serviceinstance: service instance
*   artifact: artifact
*   dataset: dataset

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest list-tag-keys --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token AAAAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4= --resource-type service --region cn-hangzhou
